# lzhuf test fixtures

`gettysburg.txt` and `gettysburg.txt.lzh` (its B2F form: CRC-16, length,
LZHUF) come from the `lzhuf/testdata` folder of wl2k-go
(https://github.com/la5nta/wl2k-go), Copyright (c) 2014-2017 Martin Hebnes
Pedersen (LA5NTA), under the MIT licence. The text is the Gettysburg
Address, in the public domain.

The short vectors in `lzhuf_test.go` ("\n", "foo", "bar" and the
quick-brown-fox line) are from wl2k-go's `lzhuf_test.go`, under the same
licence.

wl2k-go's licence text is in [LICENSE.wl2k-go](LICENSE.wl2k-go).
